name: 28768-longprefill-70b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- all eight GPUs of one a3 node, NVLink-connected, one allocation, no fabric between hosts.
parallelism: PP=8, TP=1, DP=1. One engine on the multiprocessing executor, eight pipeline stages of 10 layers, one GPU per stage.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, dense bf16 decoder: 80 layers, ~70.6 B parameters, ~141 GB across 30 safetensors shards -- 10 layers and ~17.6 GB per GPU at PP=8. Full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 32 streams, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 320 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, `request_format: plain` with `temperature: 0.0`. Every request is exactly 4000 prompt tokens and exactly 32 output tokens (min = max on both), EOS ignored so the output length is fixed. Prefix caching is off and the prompts share no reusable prefix.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing 4000-token briefs for 32 concurrent users on one eight-GPU server.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit d8874c61a55e40db4ada047f1736c38c86439fff (`git describe` =
#   v0.11.1rc6-243-gd8874c61a5 -- a commit, not a release).

model: unsloth/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct

pipeline-parallel-size: 8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: mp

enable-prefix-caching: false
enable-chunked-prefill: true

max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 32
max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
kv-cache-dtype: auto
